title: Sybil Brand Commission for Institutional Inspections (SBC) March 5, 2026 Meeting
description:
The Sybil Brand Commission for Institutional Inspections (SBC) meeting of March 5, 2026, reviewed current conditions, operational challenges, and inter agency coordination across Los Angeles County detention and justice facilities. There were updates from the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department (LASD), Correctional Health Services (CHS), and the Department of Public Health (DPH), along with inspection findings from various facilities.

The SBC emphasized ongoing concerns related to in custody deaths, the need for consistent property transfer procedures, food service quality, Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), and mental health follow up protocols, particularly regarding Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA)-   related referrals. The LASD reported progress on custodial facility contract renewals, food service modernization, and coordination with Health Services. The SBC examined gaps in water quality testing practices and requested improved interdepartmental reporting.

Facility inspections highlighted issues including outdated equipment, grievance form availability, disorganized property storage, and inconsistent documentation practices. While some facilities showed improvement, others required further follow up due to infrastructure problems or staff-related closures.

Action items assigned across agencies, focused on standardizing procedures, improving data reporting, and resolving facility specific deficiencies. Water quality reporting and special diet tracking—were continued to the next SBC meeting for comprehensive review.
